theorem: Any finite simple joint residual host for n=(a,1,1),m=(b,c^{t-1}), t>=4,a>=2,b>=c>=1 has e>=2b+(t-1)c+(t-3)min(a-1,c). If c>=a-1 and b>=a+c-1 this equals the canonical joint upper star-host size, giving exact all-host minimum J=2b+(t-3)(a+c-1)+2c.
key_graph_invariant: Delete v with degree>=b; G-v contains H=F(b,c^{t-1}) plus q edges. Recolour r=min(a-1,c) arms in each small star red. Every blue c-star except possibly one using v and one using a primary b-star edge consumes r distinct extra edges. Therefore q>=r(t-3).
former_boundary: J((2,1,1),(b,c,c,c,c))=2b+4c+2 for all b>=c+1,c>=1; former single-edge slack completely excluded
